name: io.github.giupy997/cra-agent
title: CRA AGENT
description: Lets an agent pay for x402 APIs in USDC on Arc, under a spending policy it cannot change.

environmentVariables.name: CRA_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a chmod 600 file holding the agent's private key. Never put the key in a prompt.

environmentVariables.name: CRA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional RPC endpoints, comma separated, in priority order

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Postgres for the ledger; in memory without it
